newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-HODGSON SAYS RONALDO RUMOURS DON'T HELP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HODGSON SAYS RONALDO RUMOURS DON'T HELP.

text.p: Inter Milan coach Roy Hodgson said on Tuesday that newspaper reports of Brazilian Ronaldo being poised to join the club next season did not help his strikers concentrate ahead of Wednesday's UEFA Cup final second leg.
"Every day there's a new story, we're used to it by now," the Englishman said.
"But it would certainly have been better for (Maurizio) Ganz and (Ivan) Zamorano, who play tomorrow, not to have to think about Batistuta one day and Ronaldo the next."

An Italian newspaper reported earlier that Ronaldo had agreed to join Inter from Barcelona. The Inter president Massimo Moratti later said the club was interested, along with several other clubs, but no deal had been reached.

Newspapers have also reported that Argentine striker Gabriel Batistuta is keen to leave Fiorentina for Inter, who play Germany's Schalke in the UEFA Cup final. Schalke lead 1-0 after the first leg in Germany.
